student:v4.ws.why.changes.cur: Humiling si {{name}} ng mga pagbabago. Tingnan ang mga komento.

student:v4.ws.you.doc.RENEW.en: Get a new {{label}}. This one has expired
student:v4.ws.you.doc.RENEW.cur: Kumuha ng bagong {{label}}. Expired na ang kopyang ito

student:v5.home.phaseText.ARRIVED.en: You're in Korea. Finish your steps for the first weeks: residence card, health insurance, bank and university registration.
student:v5.home.phaseText.ARRIVED.cur: Nasa Korea ka na. Tapusin ang mga hakbang sa unang mga linggo: residence card, health insurance, bangko at registration sa unibersidad.

student:v8.budget.fee.text.DUE.en: {{name}}, due to Hangyul before the team starts. Not part of what you pay the university.
student:v8.budget.fee.text.DUE.cur: {{name}}, babayaran sa Hangyul bago magsimula ang team. Hindi bahagi ng binabayaran mo sa unibersidad.

student:v8.budget.fee.text.NONE.en: Optional. You can apply on your own with the free plan; paid plans add the Hangyul team and reviews.
student:v8.budget.fee.text.NONE.cur: Opsyonal. Maaari kang mag-apply nang mag-isa gamit ang libreng plan; ang mga bayad na plan ay may kasamang Team Hangyul Univ at mga review.

student:v8.budget.fee.text.PAID.en: {{name}}, paid on {{date}}. Paid once to Hangyul, and not part of what you pay the university.
student:v8.budget.fee.text.PAID.cur: {{name}}, binayaran noong {{date}}. Isang beses na binayaran sa Hangyul, at hindi bahagi ng binabayaran mo sa unibersidad.

student:v8.compare.budget_one.en: See the full first-year budget for this program
student:v8.compare.budget_one.cur: Tingnan ang buong budget sa unang taon para sa programang ito

student:v8.compare.budget_other.en: See the full first-year budget for these {{count}} programs
student:v8.compare.budget_other.cur: Tingnan ang buong budget sa unang taon para sa {{count}} programang ito

student:v8.compare.noWinner.en: We show differences, not a winner. You decide what matters most.
student:v8.compare.noWinner.cur: Ipinapakita namin ang pagkakaiba, hindi ang panalo. Ikaw ang magpapasya kung ano ang pinakamahalaga.

student:v9.announced.rule.REFUND_TO_STUD.en: After a visa refusal, tuition would be refunded directly to an account in the student's name (standard agreement).
student:v9.announced.rule.REFUND_TO_STUD.cur: Kapag na-refuse ang visa, direktang ire-refund ang tuition sa account na nakapangalan sa estudyante (standard na kasunduan).

student:v9.announced.rule.STUDY_DEPOSIT_.en: Students from some countries without a Korean test result would deposit study funds in a bank, paid out each semester.
student:v9.announced.rule.STUDY_DEPOSIT_.cur: Ang mga estudyante mula sa ilang bansa na walang resulta sa Korean test ay magdedeposito ng pondo para sa pag-aaral sa bangko, na ilalabas bawat semestre.

student:v9.announced.rule.TOPIK4_FINANCI.en: Students with TOPIK level 4 (or KIIP level 4) would not need to show funds for the visa.
student:v9.announced.rule.TOPIK4_FINANCI.cur: Hindi na kakailanganing magpakita ng pondo para sa visa ang mga estudyanteng may TOPIK level 4 (o KIIP level 4).

student:v9.announced.title_one.en: {{count}} change announced, not in force yet

student:v9.announced.title_other.en: {{count}} changes announced, not in force yet

student:v9.discovery.scholarship_one.en: A scholarship you may qualify for
student:v9.discovery.scholarship_one.cur: Isang scholarship na posibleng pasok ka

student:v9.family.consent.en: By making the link you agree to share the parts you selected with the person you send it to. We record every time it is opened.
student:v9.family.consent.cur: Sa paggawa ng link, pumapayag kang ibahagi ang mga bahaging pinili mo sa taong padadalhan mo nito. Itinatala namin ang bawat pagbukas nito.

student:v9.family.ctaText.en: A read-only link you control. No screenshots needed.
student:v9.family.ctaText.cur: Read-only na link na ikaw ang may kontrol. Hindi kailangan ng screenshot.

student:v9.family.never.en: Never shown: your messages, essays, notes from the Hangyul team, or any document file.
student:v9.family.never.cur: Hindi kailanman ipinapakita: ang mga mensahe mo, essay, tala mula sa Team Hangyul, o anumang file ng dokumento.

student:v9.family.scope.family_documents.cur: Mga dokumentong ibibigay ng pamilya mo

student:v9.family.scopeHint.family_docum.en: Bank balance certificate and family documents: names only, never the files
student:v9.family.scopeHint.family_docum.cur: Sertipiko ng balanse sa bangko at mga dokumento ng pamilya: pangalan lang, hindi kailanman ang mga file

student:v9.funds.genuine.en: The money must actually be in the account. Putting money in only to get a certificate and then taking it out is illegal in Korea.
student:v9.funds.genuine.cur: Dapat talagang nasa account ang pera. Labag sa batas sa Korea ang maglagay ng pera para lang makakuha ng sertipiko at saka ito ilabas ulit.

student:v9.funds.kind.NOT_STATED.en: The embassy states no minimum amount. Plan for one year of tuition and living costs; the Hangyul team confirms.
student:v9.funds.kind.NOT_STATED.cur: Walang sinasabing minimum na halaga ang embassy. Maghanda ng isang taong tuition at gastusin; kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul.

student:v9.funds.longer_one.en: {{count}} month if your university is in the lower tier (rated 'consulting' by the government)
student:v9.funds.longer_one.cur: {{count}} buwan kung nasa lower tier ang unibersidad mo (na-rate na 'consulting' ng gobyerno)

student:v9.funds.longer_other.en: {{count}} months if your university is in the lower tier (rated 'consulting' by the government)
student:v9.funds.longer_other.cur: {{count}} buwan kung nasa lower tier ang unibersidad mo (na-rate na 'consulting' ng gobyerno)

student:v9.funds.status.NO_ROUTE.en: We haven't checked the money rule for your embassy yet. The Hangyul team confirms it.
student:v9.funds.status.NO_ROUTE.cur: Hindi pa namin nasusuri ang patakaran sa pera ng embassy mo. Kukumpirmahin ito ng Team Hangyul.

student:v9.funds.sub.en: For the {{type}} visa, the embassy asks to see this money in the bank. It is not paid to anyone, but it must really be yours or your family's.
student:v9.funds.sub.cur: Para sa {{type}} visa, gustong makita ng embassy ang perang ito sa bangko. Hindi ito ibinabayad kahit kanino, pero dapat ay talagang sa iyo o sa pamilya mo ito.

student:v9.funds.waived.en: Your university is in the top ('excellent') tier, so the embassy may not ask for this. The Hangyul team confirms.
student:v9.funds.waived.cur: Nasa top ('excellent') tier ang unibersidad mo, kaya baka hindi na ito hingin ng embassy. Kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul.

student:v9.funds.whose.UNKNOWN.en: Whose name: the Hangyul team confirms with the embassy
student:v9.funds.whose.UNKNOWN.cur: Kaninong pangalan: kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul Univ sa embahada

student:v9.guard.text.en: Pay the university directly, by bank transfer or the payment method the university lists, in the student's own name. Don't pay through money changers, agencies or anyone else's account: the university's account can be frozen, and refunds go only to the student's own account.
student:v9.guard.text.cur: Direktang magbayad sa unibersidad, sa bank transfer o sa paraan ng pagbabayad na nakalista ng unibersidad, sa pangalan mismo ng estudyante. Huwag magbayad sa money changer, agency o account ng ibang tao: puwedeng ma-freeze ang account ng unibersidad, at sa sariling account lang ng estudyante ibinabalik ang refund.

student:v9.money.note.HANGYUL_FEE_NONE.en: Optional. Only if you choose a Hangyul plan.
student:v9.money.note.HANGYUL_FEE_NONE.cur: Opsyonal. Kung pipili ka lang ng Hangyul plan.

student:v9.money.note.NHIS_D2.en: About this much per month, based on 2026 university notices (NHIS does not publish it). Starts when you apply for your residence card.
student:v9.money.note.NHIS_D2.cur: Mga ganito kada buwan, batay sa abiso ng mga unibersidad para sa 2026 (hindi ito inilalathala ng NHIS). Magsisimula kapag nag-apply ka para sa residence card.

student:v9.money.note.NHIS_D4.en: About this much per month (2026, university notices). For language students it starts 6 months after entry; many Korean language institutes require group insurance before that.
student:v9.money.note.NHIS_D4.cur: Mga ganito kada buwan (2026, ayon sa abiso ng mga unibersidad). Para sa language students, nagsisimula ito 6 na buwan pagdating; maraming Korean language institute ang humihingi ng group insurance bago noon.

student:v9.money.note.RESIDENCE_CARD_90_.en: For stays over 90 days. Apply within 90 days of arrival.
student:v9.money.note.RESIDENCE_CARD_90_.cur: Para sa pananatiling higit sa 90 araw. Mag-apply sa loob ng 90 araw mula pagdating.

student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_AS_PUBLIS.en: The embassy publishes this fee in words. See the official wording.
student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_AS_PUBLIS.cur: Nakasulat sa salita, hindi sa numero, ang fee na ito sa embassy. Tingnan ang opisyal na pagkakasulat.

student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_NO_ROUTE.en: We haven't checked your embassy yet. The Hangyul team confirms.
student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_NO_ROUTE.cur: Hindi pa namin nasusuri ang embassy mo. Kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul.

student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_UNKNOWN.en: Not published for your route yet. The Hangyul team confirms.
student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_UNKNOWN.cur: Hindi pa ito nakalathala para sa ruta mo. Kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul.

student:v9.money.payee.EMBASSY.en: To the Korean embassy or visa center
student:v9.money.payee.EMBASSY.cur: Sa embassy ng Korea o visa center

student:v9.money.payee.EVERYDAY.en: Food, transport and phone, paid as you go
student:v9.money.payee.EVERYDAY.cur: Pagkain, pamasahe at phone, binabayaran habang ginagamit

student:v9.money.when.BEFORE_VISA.en: Before you apply for your visa

student:v9.refund.ruleUnknown.en: The Hangyul team confirms the university's refund rule and amount with you.
student:v9.refund.ruleUnknown.cur: Kukumpirmahin sa iyo ng Team Hangyul Univ ang patakaran at halaga ng refund ng unibersidad.

student:v9.routes.degreeNotYet.en: A {{degree}} program needs a language test first, but you can start now.
student:v9.routes.degreeNotYet.cur: Kailangan muna ng language test para sa {{degree}} na programa, pero puwede ka nang magsimula ngayon.

student:v9.routes.eyebrow.en: Yes, you can study in Korea
student:v9.routes.eyebrow.cur: Oo, puwede kang mag-aral sa Korea

student:v9.routes.notOffer.en: Counted from the requirements universities publish. This is not an offer and not a prediction. Universities decide.
student:v9.routes.notOffer.cur: Binilang mula sa requirements na inilathala ng mga unibersidad. Hindi ito offer at hindi rin hula. Ang mga unibersidad ang magdedesisyon.

student:v9.sponsor.foot.en: Shared by {{name}} through Hangyul · facts as of {{date}}
student:v9.sponsor.foot.cur: Ibinahagi ni {{name}} sa pamamagitan ng Hangyul · impormasyon noong {{date}}. Ang mga unibersidad at embahada ang gumagawa ng bawat desisyon.

student:v9.sponsor.noFiles.en: Only the names of the papers are shown here, never the files.
student:v9.sponsor.noFiles.cur: Pangalan lang ng mga papeles ang ipinapakita rito, hindi kailanman ang files.

student:v9.visa.caveat.SCHEDULED_CHANGE.en: The embassy has announced new rules from {{date}} (amount, papers, language level). They are not in force yet. Today's rules apply until then.
student:v9.visa.caveat.SCHEDULED_CHANGE.cur: Nag-anunsyo ang embassy ng bagong patakaran mula {{date}} (halaga, papeles, language level). Hindi pa ito epektibo. Ang kasalukuyang patakaran ang susundin hanggang doon.

student:v9.visa.caveat.TB_POST_CONFLICT.en: The Almaty consulate and the embassy describe the TB test differently. The Hangyul team confirms which test Almaty accepts.
student:v9.visa.caveat.TB_POST_CONFLICT.cur: Magkaiba ang paglalarawan ng Almaty consulate at ng embassy sa TB test. Kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul kung aling test ang tinatanggap sa Almaty.

student:ws3.offer.step2.text.en: We let the university and the Hangyul team know.
student:ws3.offer.step2.text.cur: Ipapaalam namin sa unibersidad at sa Team Hangyul Univ.

student:ws3.offer.step4.text.en: The university issues it after payment. It's your key visa document.
student:ws3.offer.step4.text.cur: Iniisyu ito ng unibersidad pagkatapos ng bayad. Ito ang pinakamahalagang dokumento para sa visa mo.

student:ws3.tuition.how.en: Use the payment instructions in the university's offer letter (usually a bank account number created just for you, in your name). Keep the receipt, because you need it for your visa. The Hangyul team can check the instructions with you.
student:ws3.tuition.how.cur: Sundin ang payment instructions sa offer letter ng unibersidad (kadalasan ay bank account number na ginawa para lang sa iyo, nakapangalan sa iyo). Itago ang resibo dahil kailangan mo ito sa visa. Puwedeng tingnan ng Team Hangyul ang instructions kasama mo.

dossier:check.noTarget.en: Confirming only marks this as correct.
dossier:check.noTarget.cur: Ang pagkumpirma ay nagmamarka lang na tama ito.

dossier:check.willUpdate.cur: Kapag kinumpirma mo, ia-update namin ang {{target}}.

dossier:finding.POOR_SCAN.en: The image is small ({{width}}×{{height}} pixels), so the text may be hard to read. Please upload a clearer scan or a PDF.
dossier:finding.POOR_SCAN.cur: Maliit ang image ({{width}}×{{height}} pixels), kaya baka mahirap basahin ang text. Mag-upload ng mas malinaw na scan o PDF.

dossier:finding.SMALL_FILE.en: The file is very small and may be hard to read. Please upload a clearer scan or a PDF.
dossier:finding.SMALL_FILE.cur: Napakaliit ng file at baka mahirap itong basahin. Mag-upload ng mas malinaw na scan o PDF.

dossier:group.readyCount.en: Show {{count}} documents ready for every application
dossier:group.readyCount.cur: Ipakita ang {{count}} dokumentong handa para sa bawat aplikasyon

dossier:group.readyCount_one.en: Show {{count}} document ready for every application
dossier:group.readyCount_one.cur: Ipakita ang {{count}} dokumentong handa para sa bawat aplikasyon

dossier:group.readyCount_other.en: Show {{count}} documents ready for every application
dossier:group.readyCount_other.cur: Ipakita ang {{count}} dokumentong handa para sa bawat aplikasyon

dossier:home.checkDetails.en: Confirm the {{fields}} we read from your documents
dossier:home.checkDetails.cur: Kumpirmahin ang {{fields}} na nabasa namin mula sa mga dokumento mo

dossier:package.sub.en: One set of documents, matched to what each application needs.
dossier:package.sub.cur: Iisang set ng mga dokumento, itinutugma sa kailangan ng bawat aplikasyon.

dossier:page.emptyText.en: Upload your passport first. We'll show which applications it can be used for.
dossier:page.emptyText.cur: I-upload muna ang passport mo. Ipapakita namin kung saang mga aplikasyon ito magagamit.

dossier:page.method.en: Automatic checks read the text inside PDFs, not photos or scanned images. Your profile changes only when you confirm.
dossier:page.method.cur: Binabasa ng awtomatikong pagsusuri ang text sa loob ng mga PDF, hindi ang mga litrato o scanned na image. Magbabago lang ang profile mo kapag kinumpirma mo.

dossier:page.subtitle.en: Prepare each document once. We check where it can be used.
dossier:page.subtitle.cur: Ihanda ang bawat dokumento nang isang beses. Kami ang titingin kung saan ito magagamit.

dossier:reason.ESSAY_APPROVED_UPLOAD.cur: Aprubado na. I-upload ang final na bersyon.

dossier:reason.ESSAY_IN_REVIEW.en: The Hangyul team is reading your draft.
dossier:reason.ESSAY_IN_REVIEW.cur: Binabasa ng Team Hangyul ang draft mo.

dossier:reason.ESSAY_TO_WRITE.en: Write it in the Writing section first.

dossier:reason.EXPIRED.en: Expired on {{date}}. You need a newly issued copy.
dossier:reason.EXPIRED.cur: Nag-expire noong {{date}}. Kailangan mo ng bagong-issue na kopya.

dossier:reason.IN_REVIEW.en: The Hangyul team is checking it.

dossier:reason.NEAR_EXPIRY_DATE.en: Expires on {{date}}, before {{university}}'s deadline. Get a renewed copy soon.
dossier:reason.NEAR_EXPIRY_DATE.cur: Mag-e-expire sa {{date}}, bago ang deadline ng {{university}}. Kumuha agad ng renewed na kopya.

dossier:reason.NEAR_TOO_OLD.en: {{university}} needs it issued within {{days}} days. This copy will be too old after {{until}}.
dossier:reason.NEAR_TOO_OLD.cur: Kailangan ng {{university}} na na-issue ito sa loob ng {{days}} araw. Masyado nang luma ang kopyang ito pagkalipas ng {{until}}.

dossier:reason.READY.en: Ready to use as it is.
dossier:reason.READY.cur: Handa nang gamitin kung ano ito.

dossier:requests.sent.cur: Naipadala na. Nakikita na ito ng {{university}}.

dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW.en: Being checked, then ready for {{count}} applications
dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW.cur: Sinusuri pa, saka handa para sa {{count}} aplikasyon

dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW_one.en: Being checked, then ready for your application
dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW_one.cur: Sinusuri pa, saka handa para sa aplikasyon mo

dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW_other.en: Being checked, then ready for {{count}} applications
dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW_other.cur: Sinusuri pa, saka handa para sa {{count}} aplikasyon

dossier:summary.S_MISSING.en: Not uploaded yet. Needed for {{count}} applications
dossier:summary.S_MISSING.cur: Hindi pa na-upload. Kailangan sa {{count}} aplikasyon

dossier:summary.S_MISSING_one.en: Not uploaded yet. Needed for your application
dossier:summary.S_MISSING_one.cur: Hindi pa na-upload. Kailangan sa aplikasyon mo

dossier:summary.S_MISSING_other.en: Not uploaded yet. Needed for {{count}} applications
dossier:summary.S_MISSING_other.cur: Hindi pa na-upload. Kailangan sa {{count}} aplikasyon

dossier:summary.S_NOT_NEEDED.en: Not needed for your current applications. Kept for later
dossier:summary.S_NOT_NEEDED.cur: Hindi kailangan sa kasalukuyang mga aplikasyon mo. Itinatabi para sa susunod

dossier:summary.S_OPTIONAL.en: Optional for {{universities}}. It can still help your application
dossier:summary.S_OPTIONAL.cur: Opsyonal para sa {{universities}}. Puwede pa rin itong makatulong sa aplikasyon mo

dossier:upload.kept.en: Nothing to upload. We reuse your {{doc}}.
dossier:upload.kept.cur: Walang kailangang i-upload. Gagamitin namin ulit ang iyong {{doc}}.

dossier:upload.replacing.en: This replaces {{title}}. Your applications will use the new copy.
dossier:upload.replacing.cur: Papalitan nito ang {{title}}. Ang bagong kopya ang gagamitin ng mga aplikasyon mo.

dossier:upload.sendText.en: Your {{doc}} is already in your documents, so you can send it without uploading it again.
dossier:upload.sendText.cur: Nasa seksyong Mga dokumento na ang iyong {{doc}}, kaya puwede mo itong ipadala nang hindi na ina-upload ulit.

dossier:v9.who.reviewersWhy.en: They check documents before they are sent
dossier:v9.who.reviewersWhy.cur: Sinusuri nila ang mga dokumento bago ipadala

success:block.ready.en: Ready. Nothing else affects this application
success:block.ready.cur: Handa na — wala nang ibang nakaaapekto sa aplikasyong ito

success:item.DEADLINE_PASSED.why.en: The Hangyul team can check for a later round or intake.
success:item.DEADLINE_PASSED.why.cur: Puwedeng tingnan ng Team Hangyul kung may susunod na round o intake.

success:item.DEADLINE_TIGHT.why.en: Steps like legalization take weeks. Start the slowest one today.
success:item.DEADLINE_TIGHT.why.cur: Inaabot ng ilang linggo ang mga item gaya ng legalisasyon — simulan ngayon ang pinakamatagal.

success:item.DOC_IN_REVIEW.why.en: Usually within 2 working days. Nothing to do.
success:item.DOC_IN_REVIEW.why.cur: Karaniwang sa loob ng 2 araw ng trabaho — wala kang kailangang gawin.

success:item.DOC_REVIEW_LATE.why.en: It's taking longer than usual. We've told your counselor.
success:item.DOC_REVIEW_LATE.why.cur: Mas matagal ito kaysa karaniwan — minarkahan na para sa iyong tagapayo.

success:item.ESSAY_REVIEW.why.en: Nothing to do. Your counselor is reading it.
success:item.ESSAY_REVIEW.why.cur: Wala kang kailangang gawin — binabasa ito ng iyong tagapayo.

success:item.FIELD_DIFFERENT.why.en: That's fine if you chose it on purpose. Your study plan should explain why.
success:item.FIELD_DIFFERENT.why.cur: Ayos lang iyan kung sinadya mo ito — dapat ipaliwanag ng iyong plano ng pag-aaral kung bakit.

success:item.FINAL_CHECK.title.en: Everything is in. The final check is next
success:item.FINAL_CHECK.title.cur: Kumpleto na ang lahat — susunod ang huling pagsusuri

success:item.LANGUAGE_RECOMMENDED.why.en: Classes in Korean are demanding, and a higher level helps you keep up. It is not required to apply.
success:item.LANGUAGE_RECOMMENDED.why.cur: Mabigat ang mga klase sa Korean — makatutulong ang mas mataas na level para makasabay ka. Hindi ito kailangan para mag-apply.

success:item.SCHOLARSHIP_APPLY.why.en: It needs a separate application. You appear to meet its published criteria.
success:item.SCHOLARSHIP_APPLY.why.cur: Kailangan nito ng sariling aplikasyon — mukhang pasok ka sa nakalathalang pamantayan nito.

success:item.SCHOLARSHIP_NONE.why.en: You said you need one. Ask your counselor about other options.
success:item.SCHOLARSHIP_NONE.why.cur: Sinabi mong kailangan mo ng scholarship — tanungin ang iyong tagapayo tungkol sa ibang opsyon.

success:item.SUBMISSION_CONFIRM.why.en: You told us you submitted. Add the confirmation number or receipt to finish.
success:item.SUBMISSION_CONFIRM.why.cur: Sinabi mong naisumite mo na — ang numero ng kumpirmasyon o resibo ang kukumpleto rito.

success:obs.ADMITTED.en: You accepted a place at {{university}}. Your plan is set.
success:obs.ADMITTED.cur: Tinanggap ang puwesto sa {{university}} — tapos na ang plano.

success:obs.ALL_NOT_YET.en: None of your applications meets every published minimum yet. Add an option you already qualify for.
success:obs.ALL_NOT_YET.cur: Wala pa sa iyong mga aplikasyon ang pasok sa bawat nakalathalang minimum — magdagdag ng opsyong kwalipikado ka na.

success:obs.ALL_OVER_BUDGET.en: Every application is above your budget. Plan your funding or add a lower-cost option.
success:obs.ALL_OVER_BUDGET.cur: Nagsisimula sa lampas sa iyong budget ang bawat aplikasyon — planuhin ang pondo o magdagdag ng mas murang opsyon.

success:obs.ALL_POSSIBLE.en: All your applications are Possible matches. Consider adding one Strong match.
success:obs.ALL_POSSIBLE.cur: Posibleng tugma ang lahat ng iyong aplikasyon — isiping magdagdag ng isang Malakas na tugma.

success:obs.COMPARE_OFFERS.en: You have {{count}} offers. Compare them side by side before you decide.
success:obs.COMPARE_OFFERS.cur: May {{count}} alok ka — ikumpara ang mga ito nang magkakatabi bago ka magpasya.

success:obs.FEW_OPTIONS.en: You're applying to one program. A second realistic option protects you if you are not admitted.
success:obs.FEW_OPTIONS.cur: Isang programa lang ang inaaplayan mo — mapoprotektahan ka ng ikalawang makatotohanang opsyon kung hindi ito matuloy.

success:obs.MANY_APPLICATIONS.en: {{count}} applications in progress. Each needs its own essays and checks.
success:obs.MANY_APPLICATIONS.cur: {{count}} aplikasyon ang isinasagawa — bawat isa ay may sariling sanaysay at pagsusuri.

success:obs.NO_APPLICATIONS.en: You haven't started an application yet. Your Strong matches are a good place to begin.
success:obs.NO_APPLICATIONS.cur: Hindi ka pa nagsisimula ng aplikasyon — magandang simulan ang iyong mga Malakas na tugma.

success:obs.SOME_NOT_YET.en: You don't yet meet a published minimum for {{universities}}. Check that it's worth the effort.
success:obs.SOME_NOT_YET.cur: {{universities}}: may nakalathalang minimum na hindi pa naaabot — suriin kung sulit ang pagsisikap.

success:portfolio.note.en: This helps you decide. Hangyul never chooses for you. Costs are estimates before scholarships.
success:portfolio.note.cur: Tumutulong ito sa iyong pagpapasya. Hindi kailanman pumipili para sa iyo ang Hangyul. Tantya ang mga gastos bago ibawas ang scholarship.

success:portfolio.reviewed.cur: Sinuri ni {{name}} ang plano mo sa pag-apply noong {{date}}.

success:portfolio.sub.en: Your applications and saved programs together, so you can see the whole picture.
success:portfolio.sub.cur: Magkasama ang mga aplikasyon at naka-save na programa mo, para makita mo ang buong larawan.

success:submission.authorize.activeTitle.cur: Pinahintulutan — susunod na isusumite ito ng {{agency}}

success:submission.authorize.changed.en: A document changed after you gave authorization. {{agency}} will check it with you before submitting.
success:submission.authorize.changed.cur: May dokumentong nagbago pagkatapos mong magbigay ng pahintulot — susuriin ito ng {{agency}} kasama mo bago isumite.

success:submission.authorize.form.cur: Porma ng aplikasyon — mula sa iyong profile

success:submission.fee.CONFIRMED.cur: Bayad sa aplikasyon {{amount}} — kumpirmado ang bayad

success:submission.fee.PAID.en: Application fee {{amount}}. You told us it's paid
success:submission.fee.PAID.cur: Bayad sa aplikasyon {{amount}} — sinabi mong bayad na ito

success:submission.fee.UNPAID.en: Application fee {{amount}}, paid to {{payee}} on the portal
success:submission.fee.UNPAID.cur: Bayad sa aplikasyon {{amount}}, babayaran sa {{payee}} — babayaran mo ito sa portal

success:submission.fee.UNPAID_NP.en: Application fee {{amount}}. You pay it on the portal
success:submission.fee.UNPAID_NP.cur: Bayad sa aplikasyon {{amount}} — babayaran mo ito sa portal

success:submission.fee.separate.en: This is the university's application fee. It is not your Hangyul service fee or tuition.
success:submission.fee.separate.cur: Ito ang bayad sa aplikasyon ng unibersidad — hindi ito ang bayad mo sa serbisyo ng Hangyul at hindi matrikula.

success:submission.guided.enterHint.en: From your Hangyul profile. Type your passport number from the passport itself, because Hangyul keeps it only in masked form.
success:submission.guided.enterHint.cur: Mula sa iyong profile sa Hangyul. I-type ang numero ng pasaporte mula mismo sa pasaporte — naka-mask lang ito sa Hangyul.

success:submission.guided.originals.en: Keep the originals. {{university}} asks for them by post.
success:submission.guided.originals.cur: Itago ang mga orihinal — hinihingi ito ng {{university}} sa koreo.

success:submission.partial.en: Partly verified. Your counselor will confirm the details.
success:submission.partial.cur: Bahagyang na-verify — kukumpirmahin ng iyong tagapayo ang mga detalye.

success:submission.placeholder.en: Submission method not yet verified. Your counselor will confirm it.
success:submission.placeholder.cur: Hindi pa na-verify ang paraan ng pagsusumite — kukumpirmahin ito ng iyong tagapayo.

success:submission.safety.en: Never share your portal password. Hangyul will never ask for it.
success:submission.safety.cur: Huwag kailanman ibahagi ang password mo sa portal — hindi ito kailanman hihingin ng Hangyul.

success:submission.savedConfirmed.en: Confirmed. Your application is marked as submitted.
success:submission.savedConfirmed.cur: Kumpirmado — minarkahang naisumite na ang iyong aplikasyon.

success:submission.selfRequired.en: {{university}} requires you to submit the application yourself on {{portal}}. Everything is prepared, and this takes about {{minutes}} minutes.
success:submission.selfRequired.cur: Hinihingi ng {{university}} na ikaw mismo ang magsumite ng aplikasyon sa {{portal}}. Handa na ang lahat — mga {{minutes}} minuto ito.

success:submission.sessionExpired.en: Your session expired. Sign in again. Nothing was saved.
success:submission.sessionExpired.cur: Nag-expire ang iyong sesyon — pumasok ulit. Walang na-save.

success:submission.unconfirmedTitle.en: You told us you submitted. Add your confirmation to finish
success:submission.unconfirmedTitle.cur: Sinabi mong naisumite mo na — idagdag ang iyong kumpirmasyon para matapos

writing:auto.studentNote.en: An automatic check that follows rules, not a person. It points out sentences to check and never changes or writes your text.
writing:auto.studentNote.cur: Mga patakaran ito, hindi tao. Itinuturo nito ang mga pangungusap na dapat suriin — hindi nito kailanman binabago o isinusulat ang iyong teksto.

writing:finding.GENERIC_PHRASE.en: Many applicants use this phrase. A concrete detail from your own experience says more.
writing:finding.GENERIC_PHRASE.cur: Maraming aplikante ang gumagamit ng pariralang ito — mas makabuluhan ang isang tiyak na detalye mula sa sarili mong karanasan.

writing:finding.LONG_SENTENCE.en: A {{words}}-word sentence. Consider splitting it so it is easier to follow.
writing:finding.LONG_SENTENCE.cur: Pangungusap na may {{words}} salita — isiping hatiin ito para madaling masundan ng mambabasa.

writing:finding.NAME_MISSPELLED.en: Did you mean “{{expected}}” instead of “{{found}}”? Names must be exactly right.
writing:finding.NAME_MISSPELLED.cur: “{{found}}” — “{{expected}}” ba ang ibig mong sabihin? Dapat eksaktong tama ang mga pangalan.

writing:finding.NOT_SPECIFIC.en: The text never mentions {{university}} or the program. As written, it could be sent to any university.
writing:finding.NOT_SPECIFIC.cur: Hindi kailanman binabanggit ng teksto ang {{university}} o ang programa — sa pagkakasulat nito, maaari itong ipadala sa kahit anong unibersidad.

writing:finding.OTHER_PROGRAM.en: Names the {{found}} program, but this application is for {{expected}}. Check that the paragraph wasn't reused.
writing:finding.OTHER_PROGRAM.cur: Binabanggit ang programang {{found}} — ang aplikasyong ito ay para sa {{expected}}. Tiyaking hindi ginamit muli ang talata.

writing:finding.OTHER_UNIVERSITY.en: Mentions {{name}}, but this text is for {{target}}. Check that it wasn't copied from another application.
writing:finding.OTHER_UNIVERSITY.cur: Binabanggit ang {{name}} — para sa {{target}} ang tekstong ito. Tiyaking hindi ito kinopya mula sa ibang aplikasyon.

writing:finding.OVERCLAIM.en: An absolute claim. Readers trust evidence more than superlatives.
writing:finding.OVERCLAIM.cur: Isang lubos na pahayag — mas pinaniniwalaan ng mambabasa ang ebidensya kaysa sa mga superlative.

writing:finding.OVER_CHAR_LIMIT.cur: {{count}} character — {{over}} ang lampas sa limitasyong {{limit}} character.

writing:finding.OVER_LIMIT.cur: {{count}} salita — {{over}} ang lampas sa limitasyong {{limit}} salita.

writing:finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_one.en: Automatic check: {{count}} part of the question may be unanswered. Rate “Answers the question” to confirm
writing:finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_one.cur: Awtomatikong pagsusuri: maaaring hindi pa nasasagot ang {{count}} bahagi ng tanong — i-rate ang “Sinasagot ang tanong” para kumpirmahin

writing:finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_othe.en: Automatic check: {{count}} parts of the question may be unanswered. Rate “Answers the question” to confirm
writing:finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_othe.cur: Awtomatikong pagsusuri: maaaring hindi pa nasasagot ang {{count}} bahagi ng tanong — i-rate ang “Sinasagot ang tanong” para kumpirmahin

writing:finding.REPEATED_OPENER.en: {{count}} sentences start the same way. Try varying how sentences begin.
writing:finding.REPEATED_OPENER.cur: {{count}} pangungusap ang nagsisimula sa parehong paraan — ibahin ang simula ng mga pangungusap.

writing:finding.SIMILAR_TEXT.en: Passages ({{passages}}) are identical to another document in Hangyul. Talk to the student before approving, and never share the other text.
writing:finding.SIMILAR_TEXT.cur: Ang mga bahagi ({{passages}}) ay kapareho ng isa pang dokumento sa Hangyul. Kausapin ang estudyante bago aprubahan — huwag kailanman ibahagi ang ibang teksto.

writing:finding.UNDER_CHAR_LENGTH.en: {{count}} of {{limit}} characters. There is room for more detail.
writing:finding.UNDER_CHAR_LENGTH.cur: {{count}} sa {{limit}} character — may puwang pa para sa mas maraming detalye.

writing:finding.UNDER_LENGTH.en: {{count}} of {{limit}} words. There is room for more detail.
writing:finding.UNDER_LENGTH.cur: {{count}} sa {{limit}} salita — may puwang pa para sa mas maraming detalye.

writing:prompt.unknownStudent.en: We don't have this university's exact question yet. Your counselor will confirm it. You can start writing about your motivation, background and plans.
writing:prompt.unknownStudent.cur: Wala pa sa amin ang eksaktong tanong ng unibersidad na ito — kukumpirmahin ito ng iyong tagapayo. Maaari ka nang magsimulang magsulat tungkol sa iyong motibasyon, pinagmulan at mga plano.

writing:sl.LATE.en: Taking longer than expected. {{name}} is working on it.
writing:sl.LATE.cur: Mas matagal kaysa inaasahan — nasa kay {{name}} ito.

writing:sl.LATE_FLAGGED.en: Taking longer than expected. We've told the {{org}} manager. You don't need to do anything.
writing:sl.LATE_FLAGGED.cur: Mas matagal kaysa inaasahan — ipinaalam na sa manager ng {{org}}. Wala kang kailangang gawin.

writing:sl.LATE_FLAGGED_HANGYUL.en: Taking longer than expected. We've told the Hangyul team. You don't need to do anything.
writing:sl.LATE_FLAGGED_HANGYUL.cur: Mas matagal kaysa inaasahan — ipinaalam na sa team ng Hangyul. Wala kang kailangang gawin.

writing:sl.READY.cur: Handa na — bersyon {{version}} ang ginagamit ng iyong aplikasyon.

writing:student.checked.en: Checked. Nothing in your text was changed
writing:student.checked.cur: Nasuri — walang binago sa iyong teksto

writing:student.factsSub.en: They say something different from your profile. Only you can decide which is right. Fix the sentence or update your profile.
writing:student.factsSub.cur: Iba ang sinasabi ng mga ito kaysa sa iyong profile. Ikaw lang ang makapagpapasya kung alin ang tama — ayusin ang pangungusap o i-update ang iyong profile.

writing:student6.accepted.en: You accepted this. Saved as version {{version}}
writing:student6.accepted.cur: Tinanggap mo ito — na-save bilang bersyon {{version}}

writing:student6.acceptedToast.en: Suggestion accepted. Your text is updated
writing:student6.acceptedToast.cur: Tinanggap ang mungkahi — na-update ang iyong teksto

writing:student6.approvedVersion.en: Approved and used by your application

writing:student6.noComments.en: No comments yet. Your reviewer's notes will appear here, next to your text.
writing:student6.noComments.cur: Wala pang komento — lalabas dito ang mga tala ng iyong tagasuri, katabi ng iyong teksto.

writing:student6.pendingNote_one.en: {{count}} suggestion is still open. That's fine. You can choose not to accept it.
writing:student6.pendingNote_one.cur: {{count}} mungkahi pa ang bukas. Ayos lang iyan — desisyon mo ang hindi pagtanggap dito.

writing:student6.pendingNote_other.en: {{count}} suggestions are still open. That's fine. You can choose not to accept them.
writing:student6.pendingNote_other.cur: {{count}} mungkahi pa ang bukas. Ayos lang iyan — desisyon mo ang hindi pagtanggap sa mga ito.

writing:student6.usedBy.en: Version {{version}} is approved. Your {{university}} application uses it.
writing:student6.usedBy.cur: Aprubado ang bersyon {{version}} — ito ang ginagamit ng iyong aplikasyon sa {{university}}.

visaroute:caveat.AMOUNTS_CONFLICT.en: Two official pages give different amounts for proof of funds. Your counselor confirms the current one.
visaroute:caveat.AMOUNTS_CONFLICT.cur: Magkaibang halaga para sa proof of funds ang nasa dalawang opisyal na page. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo ang kasalukuyan.

visaroute:caveat.APOSTILLE_TRANSITION.en: Viet Nam started issuing apostilles on 11 Sep 2026, but the embassy's student visa lists still describe consular legalization. The Hangyul team confirms which one is accepted.
visaroute:caveat.APOSTILLE_TRANSITION.cur: Nagsimulang mag-issue ng apostille ang Viet Nam noong 11 Set 2026, pero consular legalization pa rin ang nakasulat sa student visa lists ng embassy. Kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul kung alin ang tinatanggap.

visaroute:caveat.APOSTILLE_WORDING_POSTS.en: The Mumbai checklist doesn't mention the apostille that Delhi and Chennai ask for. Your counselor confirms.
visaroute:caveat.APOSTILLE_WORDING_POSTS.cur: Hindi binabanggit ng checklist ng Mumbai ang apostille na hinihingi ng Delhi at Chennai. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo.

visaroute:caveat.CCVI_TIER_UNKNOWN.en: Depending on {{university}}'s certification level, the university may first need to apply for a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI). Your counselor checks.
visaroute:caveat.CCVI_TIER_UNKNOWN.cur: Depende sa certification level ng {{university}}, baka kailangan munang mag-apply ng unibersidad ng Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI). Susuriin ng counselor mo.

visaroute:caveat.DIPLOMA_APOSTILLE_POSTS.en: The two offices differ. Astana requires an apostille on the diploma; Almaty says it is not mandatory. Your counselor confirms what your office needs.
visaroute:caveat.DIPLOMA_APOSTILLE_POSTS.cur: Magkaiba ang dalawang opisina. Humihingi ang Astana ng apostille sa diploma; sabi ng Almaty, hindi ito mandatory. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo kung ano ang kailangan ng opisina mo.

visaroute:caveat.EVISA_TIER_UNKNOWN.en: If {{university}} holds the government's 'excellent' certification (or 'certified' for master's and doctoral study), the university can apply for an e-visa for you instead. We haven't confirmed its level. The Hangyul team checks.
visaroute:caveat.EVISA_TIER_UNKNOWN.cur: Kung may 'excellent' na certification ng gobyerno ang {{university}} (o 'certified' para sa master's at doctoral), ang unibersidad ang puwedeng mag-apply ng e-visa para sa iyo. Hindi pa namin nakukumpirma ang level nito. Susuriin ito ng Team Hangyul.

visaroute:caveat.FEES_MISSING.en: The embassy doesn't publish the fee or processing time. Your counselor confirms them.
visaroute:caveat.FEES_MISSING.cur: Hindi inilalathala ng embassy ang fee o processing time. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo.

visaroute:caveat.FEE_EXEMPTION_UNCHECKED.en: We still need to check whether Thai nationals pay the visa fee. Your counselor confirms.
visaroute:caveat.FEE_EXEMPTION_UNCHECKED.cur: Kailangan pa naming suriin kung nagbabayad ng visa fee ang mga Thai national. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo.

visaroute:caveat.FEE_TIME_CONFLICT.en: Official pages disagree on the fee and processing time. Your counselor confirms them.
visaroute:caveat.FEE_TIME_CONFLICT.cur: Hindi magkatugma ang mga opisyal na page tungkol sa fee at processing time. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo.

visaroute:caveat.FUNDS_PERIOD_CONFLICT.en: The embassy and the national manual differ on how many months of funds language students must show. Your counselor confirms.
visaroute:caveat.FUNDS_PERIOD_CONFLICT.cur: Magkaiba ang embassy at ang national manual kung ilang buwang pondo ang dapat ipakita ng language students. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo.

visaroute:caveat.LEGALIZATION_UNCLEAR.en: The embassy's list and the national visa manual differ on how your school documents must be authenticated: a translated copy or consular legalization. Your counselor confirms which one you need.
visaroute:caveat.LEGALIZATION_UNCLEAR.cur: Magkaiba ang listahan ng embassy at ang national visa manual tungkol sa kung paano dapat i-authenticate ang school documents mo: translated na kopya o consular legalization. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo kung alin ang kailangan mo.

visaroute:caveat.POST_SPLIT_UNVERIFIED.en: We couldn't confirm which regions the Manila and Cebu offices each cover. Your counselor tells you where to apply.
visaroute:caveat.POST_SPLIT_UNVERIFIED.cur: Hindi namin makumpirma kung aling mga rehiyon ang sakop ng bawat opisina sa Manila at Cebu. Sasabihin ng counselor mo kung saan ka mag-a-apply.

visaroute:caveat.POST_UNRESOLVED.en: We couldn't confirm which embassy or consulate covers your area. Your counselor tells you where to apply.
visaroute:caveat.POST_UNRESOLVED.cur: Hindi namin makumpirma kung aling embassy o consulate ang sumasakop sa lugar mo. Sasabihin ng counselor mo kung saan ka mag-a-apply.

visaroute:caveat.ROUTE_PARTIAL.en: Some details for this route are not confirmed yet. The Hangyul team checks with the embassy before you apply.
visaroute:caveat.ROUTE_PARTIAL.cur: May ilang detalye ng rutang ito na hindi pa kumpirmado. Susuriin ito ng Team Hangyul sa embassy bago ka mag-apply.

visaroute:caveat.STALE_LIST.en: The embassy's document list is from 2019. Your counselor checks that it is still current.
visaroute:caveat.STALE_LIST.cur: Galing pa noong 2019 ang listahan ng dokumento ng embassy. Susuriin ng counselor mo kung updated pa ito.

visaroute:caveat.STALE_VERIFICATION.en: These rules were last checked on {{date}}. Your counselor checks them again before you apply.
visaroute:caveat.STALE_VERIFICATION.cur: Huling nasuri ang mga patakarang ito noong {{date}}. Susuriin ulit ito ng counselor mo bago ka mag-apply.

visaroute:caveat.TB_VALIDITY_CONFLICT.en: Official pages disagree on how long the TB certificate is valid (3 or 6 months). We use the stricter 3 months.
visaroute:caveat.TB_VALIDITY_CONFLICT.cur: Hindi magkatugma ang mga opisyal na page kung gaano katagal valid ang TB certificate (3 o 6 na buwan). Ginagamit namin ang mas mahigpit na 3 buwan.

visaroute:caveat.title.cur: Mga detalyeng kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul

visaroute:cond.LOWER_TIER.en: Only for some universities. Your counselor confirms.
visaroute:cond.LOWER_TIER.cur: Para sa ilang unibersidad lang. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo.

visaroute:cond.OTHER.en: Only in some cases. The Hangyul team confirms.
visaroute:cond.OTHER.cur: Sa ilang kaso lang. Kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul.

visaroute:cond.POST_SPECIFIC.en: Only some embassies or consulates ask for this. It depends on where you apply.
visaroute:cond.POST_SPECIFIC.cur: Ilang embassy o consulate lang ang humihingi nito. Depende kung saan ka mag-a-apply.

visaroute:doc.business_registration.why.en: The university's business registration. It comes with your admission papers.
visaroute:doc.business_registration.why.cur: Ang business registration ng unibersidad. Kasama itong darating ng admission papers mo.

visaroute:doc.criminal_record.why.en: Shows you have no criminal record. Issued by the police.
visaroute:doc.criminal_record.why.cur: Pinapakita na wala kang criminal record. Inii-issue ng pulis.

visaroute:doc.other_address_certificate..en: Proves where you live, which decides where you apply.
visaroute:doc.other_address_certificate..cur: Pinatutunayan kung saan ka nakatira, na siyang nagpapasya kung saan ka mag-a-apply.

visaroute:doc.other_air_ticket_booking.w.en: A booking, not a paid ticket. Some embassies ask for it.
visaroute:doc.other_air_ticket_booking.w.cur: Booking lang, hindi bayad na ticket. Hinihingi ito ng ilang embassy.

visaroute:doc.other_declaration_form.why.en: The embassy's or consulate's own form. You sign it yourself.
visaroute:doc.other_declaration_form.why.cur: Sariling form ng embassy o consulate. Ikaw mismo ang pipirma.

visaroute:doc.other_health_condition_rep.en: A health form some embassies and consulates ask for.
visaroute:doc.other_health_condition_rep.cur: Health form na hinihingi ng ilang embassy at consulate.

visaroute:doc.other_passport_record.name.en: Passport issuance record (from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
visaroute:doc.other_passport_record.name.cur: Record ng pag-issue ng pasaporte (mula sa Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

visaroute:doc.other_training_plan.name.cur: Plano ng training program (mula sa institusyon)

visaroute:doc.sponsor_documents.why.en: ID and proof of income or employment for the person paying your costs.
visaroute:doc.sponsor_documents.why.cur: ID at patunay ng kita o trabaho ng taong sasagot sa mga gastos mo.

visaroute:doc.tb_test.why.en: Required for your nationality for stays over 90 days. Get it from a clinic the embassy designates.
visaroute:doc.tb_test.why.cur: Kailangan ito para sa nasyonalidad mo kung mananatili ka nang higit 90 araw. Kunin ito sa clinic na itinalaga ng embassy.

visaroute:docs.maybeSub.en: The Hangyul team confirms whether these apply to you.
visaroute:docs.maybeSub.cur: Kukumpirmahin ng Team Hangyul kung para sa iyo ang mga ito.

visaroute:docs.previewSub.en: From the embassy's list for your nationality. The full plan opens once your university issues your admission letter.
visaroute:docs.previewSub.cur: Mula sa listahan ng embassy para sa nasyonalidad mo. Mabubuksan ang buong plan kapag na-issue na ng unibersidad ang iyong admission letter.

visaroute:docs.readyCount.cur: {{count}} ang handa, {{reused}} ang ginamit ulit mula sa Mga dokumento mo

visaroute:form.correctedHint.en: You changed this here only. If it's wrong in your profile, update it there too.
visaroute:form.correctedHint.cur: Dito mo lang ito binago. Kung mali rin ito sa profile mo, i-update mo rin doon.

visaroute:form.missingHint.en: We don't have this. You'll write it on the official form.
visaroute:form.missingHint.cur: Wala kami nito. Isusulat mo ito sa opisyal na form.

visaroute:form.notice.en: For your preparation only. You'll fill in and sign the official form yourself (or your university applies for the e-visa). Hangyul never submits or declares anything for you.
visaroute:form.notice.cur: Para lang sa iyong paghahanda. Ikaw mismo ang sasagot at pipirma sa opisyal na form (o ang iyong unibersidad ang magfa-file ng e-visa). Hindi kailanman nagsusumite o nagdedeklara ng anuman ang Hangyul para sa iyo.

visaroute:help.askHint.en: Your question goes to the Hangyul team and its visa specialists.
visaroute:help.askHint.cur: Mapupunta ang tanong mo sa Team Hangyul at sa mga visa specialist nito.

visaroute:help.issue.IN_KOREA.needed.en: A change of status goes through the immigration office. Your counselor guides you.
visaroute:help.issue.IN_KOREA.needed.cur: Sa immigration office dumadaan ang pagpapalit ng status. Gagabayan ka ng counselor mo.

visaroute:help.issue.NEEDS_ANSWER.needed.en: Answer the question above and we'll tell you which embassy or consulate to apply to.
visaroute:help.issue.NEEDS_ANSWER.needed.cur: Sagutin ang tanong sa itaas at sasabihin namin kung saang embahada o konsulado ka mag-a-apply.

visaroute:help.issue.OTHER_RESIDENCE.nee.en: Your counselor checks whether the Korean embassy or consulate where you live accepts your application.
visaroute:help.issue.OTHER_RESIDENCE.nee.cur: Susuriin ng counselor mo kung tatanggapin ng Korean embassy o consulate kung saan ka nakatira ang aplikasyon mo.

visaroute:help.sent.en: Sent. Your counselor will reply in Messages.
visaroute:help.sent.cur: Naipadala na. Sasagot ang counselor mo sa Messages.

visaroute:home.choose_post.en: Tell us where you live so we can find the right embassy
visaroute:home.choose_post.cur: Sabihin sa amin kung saan ka nakatira para mahanap namin ang tamang embahada

visaroute:home.embassy_request.en: The embassy asked for something. Send it by {{date}}
visaroute:home.embassy_request.cur: May hinihingi ang embassy. Ipadala bago o sa {{date}}

visaroute:home.refused.en: Your visa was refused. Your counselor will help you with the next step
visaroute:home.refused.cur: Na-refuse ang visa mo. Tutulungan ka ng counselor mo sa susunod na hakbang

visaroute:home.wait_decision.en: Visa application submitted. Waiting for the embassy
visaroute:home.wait_decision.cur: Naisumite na ang visa application. Hinihintay ang embassy

visaroute:home.waiting.en: Your visa documents are being handled. Nothing to do right now
visaroute:home.waiting.cur: Inaasikaso ang mga dokumento mo para sa visa. Wala kang kailangang gawin ngayon

visaroute:method.CCVI.en: university gets a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI), then you apply at the embassy
visaroute:method.CCVI.cur: kukuha ang unibersidad ng Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI), saka ka mag-a-apply sa embassy

visaroute:methodNote.ACCREDITED_ONLY.en: You can apply only through agencies the embassy has accredited. Check the embassy's list.
visaroute:methodNote.ACCREDITED_ONLY.cur: Sa mga agency lang na accredited ng embassy ka puwedeng mag-apply. Tingnan ang listahan ng embassy.

visaroute:methodNote.AGENCIES_ONLY_FROM_.en: From 1 Oct 2026, this embassy or consulate takes applications only through its designated travel agencies.
visaroute:methodNote.AGENCIES_ONLY_FROM_.cur: Mula 1 Okt 2026, tumatanggap lang ang embassy o consulate na ito ng aplikasyon sa pamamagitan ng mga itinalaga nitong travel agency.

visaroute:methodNote.G4K_BOOKING.en: Book online at g4k.go.kr, then go to the consulate in person. No one can apply for you.
visaroute:methodNote.G4K_BOOKING.cur: Mag-book online sa g4k.go.kr, saka personal na pumunta sa consulate. Walang puwedeng mag-apply para sa iyo.

visaroute:page.subtitle.en: Your visa plan for your country and university: what you need, in what order, and where to apply.
visaroute:page.subtitle.cur: Ang visa plan para sa bansa at unibersidad mo: ano ang kailangan, sa anong pagkakasunod-sunod, at saan mag-a-apply.

visaroute:question.unsure.en: Not sure? Ask the Hangyul team.
visaroute:question.unsure.cur: Hindi sigurado? Magtanong sa Team Hangyul.

visaroute:question.why.en: Each embassy or consulate accepts students only from the area it covers. This decides where you apply.
visaroute:question.why.cur: Tumatanggap lang ang bawat embassy o consulate ng mga estudyante mula sa lugar na sakop nito. Ito ang magpapasya kung saan ka mag-a-apply.

visaroute:reason.EXPIRED.en: It has expired. You need a newly issued copy.
visaroute:reason.EXPIRED.cur: Expired na ito. Kailangan mo ng bagong-issue na kopya.

visaroute:reason.GET_LATER.en: Don't get it yet. Get it on or after {{date}} so it's still valid on {{appointment}}.
visaroute:reason.GET_LATER.cur: Huwag pa itong kunin. Kunin ito sa o pagkatapos ng {{date}} para valid pa ito sa {{appointment}}.

visaroute:reason.NEAR_EXPIRY_DATE.en: Expires on {{date}}. Renew it before you apply.
visaroute:reason.NEAR_EXPIRY_DATE.cur: Mag-e-expire sa {{date}}. I-renew ito bago ka mag-apply.

visaroute:reason.PASSPORT_VALIDITY.en: Your passport expires on {{date}}. Many embassies ask for at least 6 months of validity.
visaroute:reason.PASSPORT_VALIDITY.cur: Mag-e-expire ang passport mo sa {{date}}. Maraming embassy ang humihingi ng hindi bababa sa 6 na buwang validity.

visaroute:reason.READY.cur: Handa na. Gagamitin ulit nang walang babaguhin.

visaroute:reason.TB_AT_REGISTRATION.en: With the e-visa, you submit the TB certificate when you register as a foreign resident in Korea.
visaroute:reason.TB_AT_REGISTRATION.cur: Sa e-visa, isusumite mo ang TB certificate kapag nagparehistro ka bilang foreign resident sa Korea.

visaroute:reason.VISA_ONLY.en: Only the visa needs this. It isn't in your documents yet.
visaroute:reason.VISA_ONLY.cur: Sa visa lang ito kailangan. Wala pa ito sa seksyong Mga dokumento.

visaroute:reason.WAITING_UNIVERSITY.en: {{university}} sends this. Nothing to do until it arrives.
visaroute:reason.WAITING_UNIVERSITY.cur: Ang {{university}} ang magpapadala nito. Wala kang kailangang gawin hanggang dumating ito.

visaroute:route.feeAmount.en: {{amount}} {{currency}}, paid to the embassy, not to Hangyul
visaroute:route.feeAmount.cur: {{amount}} {{currency}}, binabayaran sa embassy, hindi sa Hangyul

visaroute:route.feeUnknown.en: The fee isn't confirmed. Your counselor checks the current amount.
visaroute:route.feeUnknown.cur: Hindi pa kumpirmado ang fee. Susuriin ng counselor mo ang kasalukuyang halaga.

visaroute:route.postPending.en: Where you apply depends on where you live. Answer one question below.
visaroute:route.postPending.cur: Nakadepende kung saan ka mag-a-apply sa kung saan ka nakatira. Sagutin ang isang tanong sa ibaba.

visaroute:route.processing.en: Processing time, in the embassy's own words
visaroute:route.processing.cur: Processing time, ayon sa sariling salita ng embassy

visaroute:state.IN_KOREA.en: You're already in Korea. You change your visa status at an immigration office, not at an embassy. Your counselor guides you.
visaroute:state.IN_KOREA.cur: Nasa Korea ka na. Sa immigration office ka magpapalit ng visa status, hindi sa embassy. Gagabayan ka ng counselor mo.

visaroute:state.NEEDS_PROGRAM.en: Choose a programme first. The visa type depends on what you study.
visaroute:state.NEEDS_PROGRAM.cur: Pumili muna ng programa. Nakadepende ang uri ng visa sa pag-aaralan mo.

visaroute:state.NO_ROUTE.en: We haven't verified the rules for {{country}} yet. Your counselor confirms them.
visaroute:state.NO_ROUTE.cur: Hindi pa namin na-verify ang mga patakaran para sa {{country}}. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo.

visaroute:state.OTHER_RESIDENCE.en: You live in {{country}}, so you usually apply at the Korean embassy or consulate there. We haven't verified that route. Your counselor confirms it.
visaroute:state.OTHER_RESIDENCE.cur: Nakatira ka sa {{country}}, kaya kadalasan ay sa Korean embassy o consulate doon ka mag-a-apply. Hindi pa namin na-verify ang rutang iyon. Kukumpirmahin ng counselor mo.

visaroute:step.apply.why.en: Submit your documents, then enter the receipt number here.
visaroute:step.apply.why.cur: Ipasa ang iyong mga dokumento, saka itala rito ang numero ng resibo.

visaroute:step.documents.why.en: We reuse what you already have. Add only what is new for the visa.
visaroute:step.documents.why.cur: Gagamitin namin ulit ang mayroon ka na. Idagdag lang ang bago para sa visa.

visaroute:step.fresh_items.title.cur: Kunin sa huli ang mga dokumentong may limitadong bisa

visaroute:step.slow_items.title.cur: Unahin ang mga dokumentong pinakamatagal makuha

visaroute:step.slow_items.why.en: Apostilles or consular legalization, the TB test and police certificates can take weeks.
visaroute:step.slow_items.why.cur: Puwedeng abutin nang ilang linggo ang apostille o consular legalization, ang TB test at ang police clearance.

visaroute:step.university_papers.title.cur: Mga dokumento mula sa unibersidad mo

visaroute:step.university_papers.why.en: The admission letter and business registration certificate come from the university.
visaroute:step.university_papers.why.cur: Mula sa unibersidad ang liham ng pagtanggap at ang business registration certificate.

visaroute:timing.noDate.en: Must be issued within {{days}} days before you apply. Choose your application date first, then get it.
visaroute:timing.noDate.cur: Dapat na-issue sa loob ng {{days}} araw bago ka mag-apply. Piliin muna ang petsa ng application mo, saka ito kunin.

visaroute:track.appointmentHint.en: Book it through the embassy's official system, then note the date here. We check that your documents are still valid on that day.
visaroute:track.appointmentHint.cur: Mag-book sa opisyal na system ng embassy, saka itala rito ang petsa. Susuriin namin kung valid pa ang mga dokumento mo sa araw na iyon.

visaroute:track.handoffText.en: You'll book on the embassy's official page. Your plan stays here, so come back and note the date and your receipt number.
visaroute:track.handoffText.cur: Sa opisyal na page ng embassy ka magbo-book. Nananatili rito ang plan mo, kaya bumalik para itala ang petsa at ang receipt number mo.

visaroute:track.issuedDone.en: Visa issued on {{date}}. Plan your arrival next.
visaroute:track.issuedDone.cur: Na-issue ang visa noong {{date}}. Susunod, planuhin ang pagdating mo.

visaroute:track.issuedText.en: Upload your visa (or the e-visa grant notice). Then you can start your arrival plan.
visaroute:track.issuedText.cur: I-upload ang iyong visa (o ang e-visa grant notice). Saka mo masisimulan ang arrival plan mo.

visaroute:v5.formDone.cur: Nasuri na ang lahat ng seksyon. I-review ang mga ito

visaroute:v5.helpAsk.en: Ask the Hangyul team about your visa
visaroute:v5.helpAsk.cur: Magtanong sa Team Hangyul tungkol sa visa mo

visaroute:verify.PARTIAL.en: Mostly confirmed on {{date}}. Some details below are still being checked.
visaroute:verify.PARTIAL.cur: Karamihan ay nakumpirma noong {{date}}. Sinusuri pa ang ilang detalye sa ibaba.

visaroute:why.CCVI_POSSIBLE.en: Your university may also apply for a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI) for you. Your counselor tells you if it will.
visaroute:why.CCVI_POSSIBLE.cur: Puwede ring mag-apply ang unibersidad mo ng Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI) para sa iyo. Sasabihin ng counselor mo kung gagawin nila ito.

visaroute:why.CCVI_REQUIRED.en: For your nationality and this programme at {{university}}, the university must first get a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI).
visaroute:why.CCVI_REQUIRED.cur: Para sa nasyonalidad mo at sa programang ito sa {{university}}, kailangan munang kumuha ng unibersidad ng Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI).

visaroute:why.EVISA_TIER.en: {{university}} is certified for the e-visa, so the university applies for it for you. You don't need to visit the embassy.
visaroute:why.EVISA_TIER.cur: Certified ang {{university}} para sa e-visa, kaya ang unibersidad ang mag-a-apply nito para sa iyo. Hindi mo kailangang pumunta sa embassy.

visaroute:why.POST_BY_REGION.en: You live in the area that the Korean embassy or consulate in {{city}} covers, so you apply there.
visaroute:why.POST_BY_REGION.cur: Nakatira ka sa lugar na sakop ng Korean embassy o consulate sa {{city}}, kaya doon ka mag-a-apply.

visaroute:why.POST_FOR_COUNTRY.en: Students living in {{country}} apply at the Korean embassy or consulate in {{city}}.
visaroute:why.POST_FOR_COUNTRY.cur: Sa Korean embassy o consulate sa {{city}} nag-a-apply ang mga estudyanteng nakatira sa {{country}}.

visaroute:why.rule.en: Apply where you live (or where you last studied), and only through the embassy's official channels.
visaroute:why.rule.cur: Mag-apply kung saan ka nakatira (o kung saan ka huling nag-aral), at sa opisyal na channels lang ng embassy.

concierge:arrived.confirmText.en: We'll record today as your arrival date. You need to apply for your residence card within 90 days.
concierge:arrived.confirmText.cur: Itatala namin ang araw na ito bilang petsa ng pagdating mo. Kailangan mong mag-apply ng residence card sa loob ng 90 araw.

concierge:arrived.text.en: Tell us you've arrived. We'll start your residence card countdown and show your steps for the first weeks.
concierge:arrived.text.cur: Sabihin sa amin na nakarating ka na — sisimulan namin ang countdown para sa iyong kard ng paninirahan at lilipat sa mga hakbang sa unang mga linggo.

concierge:cost.included.en: Included in your Hangyul plan at no extra cost
concierge:cost.included.cur: Kasama sa iyong Hangyul plan — walang dagdag na bayad

concierge:emergency.note.en: In an emergency, call first. Then tell the Hangyul team.
concierge:emergency.note.cur: Kung may emergency, tumawag muna. Saka sabihan ang Team Hangyul.

concierge:feedback.gaveNo.en: You told us this didn't go well. Your team will contact you.
concierge:feedback.gaveNo.cur: Sinabi mong hindi ito naging maayos — kikilos ang iyong team.

concierge:feedback.thanks.en: Thank you. This helps us improve.
concierge:feedback.thanks.cur: Salamat — nakatutulong ito para mapabuti namin ang serbisyo.

concierge:flight.notLive.en: You or your counselor enter the flight times. They are not live airline data.
concierge:flight.notLive.cur: Ikaw o ang iyong tagapayo ang naglagay ng oras ng lipad — hindi ito live na datos ng airline.

concierge:help.sentOps.en: Sent. Hangyul's operations team has it.
concierge:help.sentOps.cur: Naipadala — nasa operations team ng Hangyul na ito.

concierge:help.sentTeam.cur: Naipadala — nasa iyong tagapayo na ito.

concierge:help.sideText.en: Ask about housing, your university, visa, documents or payments in one place.
concierge:help.sideText.cur: Magtanong tungkol sa tirahan, unibersidad, visa, dokumento o bayad sa iisang lugar.

concierge:help.subtitle.en: Tell us what happened. The right person on your team gets it immediately.
concierge:help.subtitle.cur: Sabihin sa amin ang nangyari. Agad itong matatanggap ng tamang tao sa team mo.

concierge:hero.admitted.cur: Natanggap ka na. Binabati ka namin!

concierge:hero.arrived.en: Welcome to Korea! You arrived on {{date}}.
concierge:hero.arrived.cur: Maligayang pagdating sa Korea! Dumating ka noong {{date}}.

concierge:housing.askedToast.en: Sent. Your team will arrange a viewing.
concierge:housing.askedToast.cur: Naipadala — mag-aayos ang iyong team ng pagtingin sa lugar.

concierge:housing.compare.OFF_CAMPUS.en: More choice and privacy. You need a deposit (often large) and a contract. Your counselor can review it with you before you sign.
concierge:housing.compare.OFF_CAMPUS.cur: Mas maraming pagpipilian at privacy. Kailangan ng deposito (kadalasang malaki) at kontrata — maaari itong suriin ng iyong tagapayo kasama mo bago ka pumirma.

concierge:housing.dormExplain.NOT_ASSIGN.en: No room this time. Your counselor will help you with other options.
concierge:housing.dormExplain.NOT_ASSIGN.cur: Walang kuwarto sa pagkakataong ito — tutulungan ka ng iyong tagapayo sa ibang opsyon.

concierge:housing.foundOwnSub.en: Share the contract before you sign. Your counselor checks it with you.
concierge:housing.foundOwnSub.cur: Ibahagi ang kontrata bago pumirma — susuriin ito ng iyong tagapayo kasama mo.

concierge:housing.honest.en: We show only dormitory facts with a source, and only rooms a provider has actually offered, each labeled. We never invent listings.
concierge:housing.honest.cur: Ipinapakita lang namin ang impormasyon sa dormitoryo na may source, at ang mga kuwartong talagang inalok ng provider, bawat isa ay may label. Hindi kami nag-iimbento ng listing.

concierge:housing.listingsSub.en: Every room comes from a named provider.
concierge:housing.listingsSub.cur: Bawat kuwarto ay mula sa isang pinangalanang provider.

concierge:housing.subtitle.en: Choose where you'll live. We'll guide you through the rest.
concierge:housing.subtitle.cur: Piliin kung saan ka titira. Gagabayan ka namin sa iba pa.

concierge:housing.tempRequested.en: Sent. Your team will suggest options.
concierge:housing.tempRequested.cur: Naipadala — magmumungkahi ang iyong team ng mga opsyon.

concierge:lease.intro.en: Upload the proposed contract and fill in what you can read. Your counselor reviews it with you. We check for missing or unclear terms. This is not legal advice.
concierge:lease.intro.cur: I-upload ang iminumungkahing kontrata at punan ang kaya mong basahin. Susuriin ito ng iyong tagapayo kasama mo. Tinitingnan namin kung may kulang o hindi malinaw na tuntunin — hindi ito legal na payo.

concierge:lease.sent.en: Sent. Your counselor will review it with you.
concierge:lease.sent.cur: Naipadala — susuriin ito ng iyong tagapayo kasama mo.

concierge:moveIn.item.address_report.tex.en: Once you have a residence card, you must report your new address within 15 days of moving.
concierge:moveIn.item.address_report.tex.cur: Kapag may residence card ka na, dapat mong iulat ang bagong address mo sa loob ng 15 araw pagkalipat.

concierge:official.needsReview.en: We're still confirming this with the official source. Check with your counselor before you rely on it.
concierge:official.needsReview.cur: Kinukumpirma pa namin ito sa opisyal na source — magtanong muna sa iyong tagapayo bago ka umasa rito.

concierge:page.subtitle.en: From where you'll live to your residence card, one step at a time.
concierge:page.subtitle.cur: Mula sa titirhan mo hanggang sa residence card mo, isa-isang hakbang.

concierge:pickup.explain.FLIGHT_DELAYED.en: Your flight is late, so the pickup time has been moved. You don't need to do anything.
concierge:pickup.explain.FLIGHT_DELAYED.cur: Late ang iyong lipad — inilipat na ang oras ng sundo. Wala kang kailangang gawin.

concierge:pickup.explain.NO_SHOW.en: The driver couldn't find you. Your team will contact you, or you can open 'Need help in Korea?'.
concierge:pickup.explain.NO_SHOW.cur: Hindi ka nahanap ng driver. Kokontakin ka ng iyong team — o buksan ang 'Kailangan mo ba ng tulong sa Korea?'.

concierge:pickup.handle.en: Your username or phone number on that app
concierge:pickup.handle.cur: Ang username o phone number mo sa app na iyon

concierge:pickup.needFlight.en: Add your flight first. We plan the pickup around your arrival time.
concierge:pickup.needFlight.cur: Idagdag muna ang iyong lipad — nakaplano ang sundo batay sa oras ng iyong pagdating.

concierge:pickup.requested.en: Pickup requested. Your team will confirm it.
concierge:pickup.requested.cur: Nahiling na ang sundo — kukumpirmahin ito ng iyong team.

concierge:profile.sub.en: We only ask what affects your options.
concierge:profile.sub.cur: Itatanong lang namin ang mga bagay na nakaaapekto sa pagpipilian mo.

concierge:residence.bookText.en: HiKorea is the government website. Hangyul can't book for you or store your HiKorea password. Book there, then come back and tell us the date.
concierge:residence.bookText.cur: Ang HiKorea ay website ng gobyerno. Hindi makakapag-book ang Hangyul para sa iyo at hindi namin itatago ang HiKorea password mo. Mag-book doon, saka bumalik at sabihin sa amin ang petsa.

concierge:residence.groupNo.en: Your university does not apply as a group. Book your own visit on HiKorea.
concierge:residence.groupNo.cur: Hindi nagfa-file nang grupo ang iyong unibersidad — mag-book ng sarili mong pagpunta sa HiKorea.

concierge:residence.groupUnknown.en: Ask your international office whether they apply for residence cards as a group. If not, book your own visit on HiKorea.
concierge:residence.groupUnknown.cur: Tanungin ang international office mo kung sila ang nag-a-apply ng residence card nang grupo. Kung hindi, mag-book ng sarili mong appointment sa HiKorea.

concierge:residence.groupYes.en: Your university applies for residence cards as a group. You can choose that instead of booking your own visit.
concierge:residence.groupYes.cur: Nagfa-file ng kard ng paninirahan nang grupo ang iyong unibersidad — maaari mong piliin iyon sa halip na mag-book ng sarili mong pagpunta.

concierge:residence.lateText.en: Contact your counselor today. They'll help you with the immigration office.
concierge:residence.lateText.cur: Kontakin ang iyong tagapayo ngayong araw — tutulungan ka nila sa tanggapan ng imigrasyon.

concierge:residence.useGroup.en: My university is applying for me
concierge:residence.useGroup.cur: Ang unibersidad ko ang nag-a-apply para sa akin

concierge:residence.waiting.en: Submitted. The card usually takes one to several weeks, depending on the office. Don't leave Korea while you wait unless immigration says you can.
concierge:residence.waiting.cur: Naisumite na — karaniwang inaabot ng isa hanggang ilang linggo ang card, depende sa opisina. Huwag umalis ng Korea habang hinihintay ito maliban kung sinabi ng immigration na puwede.

concierge:step.documents_to_carry.text.en: Keep the originals in your hand luggage. You'll need them for your residence card in your first weeks:
concierge:step.documents_to_carry.text.cur: Itago ang mga orihinal sa iyong hand-carry na bagahe — kakailanganin mo ang mga ito para sa iyong kard ng paninirahan sa unang mga linggo:

concierge:step.pickup.sub.en: Your pickup partner meets you at arrivals
concierge:step.pickup.sub.cur: Sasalubungin ka ng pickup partner mo sa arrival area

concierge:step.residence_card.why.en: The law requires it if you stay longer than 90 days. You'll need it for your bank account, phone plan and more.
concierge:step.residence_card.why.cur: Kailangan ito ayon sa batas kung mananatili ka nang higit sa 90 araw. Kakailanganin mo rin ito para sa bank account, phone plan at iba pa.

concierge:step.residence_setup.text.en: After you land, register for a residence card within 90 days and join National Health Insurance.
concierge:step.residence_setup.text.cur: Ang mangyayari pagkalapag mo: magparehistro para sa kard ng paninirahan sa loob ng 90 araw at sumali sa National Health Insurance.

concierge:step.sim_esim.title.en: Phone number and data (SIM or eSIM)
concierge:step.sim_esim.title.cur: Numero ng telepono at data (SIM o eSIM)

mobile:v3.quick.dataUnverified.en: Some program details here are not yet verified. Confirm them on the university's official website.
mobile:v3.quick.dataUnverified.cur: May ilang detalye ng programa rito na hindi pa na-verify. Kumpirmahin sa opisyal na website ng unibersidad.
